images.author: unknown
images.why: Grayscale fallback: CDC's indexed image identifies tick-borne encephalitis virus particles within infected tissue. No qualifying colour version found; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: Robert Koch Institute
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies negatively stained TBEV particles, with a 100 nm scale bar. Grayscale fallback; downloadable JPEG listed as 570 KB. Custom terms permit specified reporting/scientific uses but prohibit changing the motif, so a 9:10 crop is not clearly permitted.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Colourised TEM of one spherical MERS-CoV virion; single-particle composition suits a near-square card. This direct URL is the low-resolution preview; the page offers a 4.36 MB original whose direct URL could not be verified.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Colourised TEM explicitly showing five yellow MERS-CoV virions; portrait composition is close to 9:10. Direct URL is the low-resolution preview; the page lists an 11.18 MB original.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Alternative colourised TEM of a single MERS-CoV virion, suitable for a prominent central subject. Direct URL is the low-resolution preview; the page lists a 9.98 MB original.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Caption confirms three spherical MERS-CoV virions in a digitally colourised TEM. Direct URL is the low-resolution preview; the page lists a 24.12 MB original.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Colourised TEM showing multiple spherical MERS-CoV particles and their ultrastructure. Direct URL is the low-resolution preview; the page lists a 21.79 MB original.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Colourised SEM showing yellow MERS-CoV particles on a blue Vero E6 cell; strong colour separation for a full-bleed card. Direct URL is the low-resolution preview; the page lists a 14.94 MB original.

images.author: Dr. Mary Ng Mah Lee, National University of Singapore
images.why: Colourised SEM from 2004 showing SARS-infected Vero E6 cells with virus particles emerging from layered surfaces. Contains small arrows/arrowheads. Direct URL is the low-resolution preview; the page lists a 15.92 MB original.

images.author: Charles D. Humphrey and T. G. Ksiazek
images.why: Negative-stain TEM explicitly captioned as SARS virions from a tissue-culture isolate, dated 2003. Shows characteristic surrounding spikes, with small arrowheads. Direct URL is the low-resolution preview; the page lists a 0.99 MB original.

images.author: C. S. Goldsmith and T. G. Ksiazek
images.why: Thin-section TEM explicitly identifying SARS virions in a tissue-culture isolate, dated 2003, establishing the original SARS-CoV identity. Direct URL is the low-resolution preview; the page lists a 6.5 MB original.
